title: How should every feedback finding be dispositioned?
question: How should every feedback finding be dispositioned?
answer: RB-Q5: Suggested A with four classes: every finding gets exactly one disposition in its owning Spec, and REPORT_FORMAT.md requires the field: diagnostic (doctor code with mandatory remediation), test, declined (with reason), accepted-open (real, unscheduled, naming the owning Spec). A suite test fails if any registered doctor finding lacks remediation text.
